I've planned all eight laws as nine nodes, and the harness validator accepts all nine. Six can go to coding now; three carry gaps and stay blocked until the operator decides them.

| Node | Result |
|---|---|
| `NRS_484B_777_1_o1` – ride as near the right side as practicable | Ready to code |
| `NRS_484B_777_1_o2` – due care when passing a standing or same-direction vehicle | Ready to code; marked as a surrogate (its verdicts are evidence, not a legal conclusion) |
| `NRS_484B_777_3` – no more than two abreast | Ready to code |
| `NRS_484B_785_1a` – e-scooter at most 15 mph on roadway, bike lane or path | Ready to code |
| `NRS_484D_165_3` – lamps on a parked or stopped vehicle | Ready to code |
| `NRS_484D_165_4` – parked vehicle's headlamps dimmed | Ready to code |
| `NRS_484B_769` – hand signals for bikes and scooters | Blocked: nothing records which arm is used or which way it points (gap `sig.hand_signal_posture`) |
| `NRS_484B_913` – driving over a fire hose | Blocked: nothing tells a bare hose from one under a hose bridge, and the fire official in command is not one of the roles that can direct traffic (two gaps) |
| `NRS_484D_100_1` – when lamps must be lit | Blocked: re-carries the still-pending gap G21 for "when directed by an official traffic control device" |

Choices worth reviewing:
- **Keep-right lane width:** the proposed `p.shared_lane_min_width` (14 ft, from shared-lane guidance) makes most ordinary urban lanes count as "too narrow" under the law's exception. In practice that excuses riders from keeping right in most lanes, so this one value largely decides how often `NRS_484B_777_1_o1` applies.
- **Lone riders:** I read "commensurate with the speed of any nearby traffic" as met when no traffic is nearby, so a rider alone is never required to keep right.
- **Lawful speed:** "a lawful rate of speed" checks compliance with the scooter speed limit (`NRS_484B_785_1a`). For bicycles and e-bikes that rule doesn't apply, so they always count as lawful.
- **Exceptions and due care:** I read the keep-right exceptions as not excusing due care when passing. Exception (c) is about "doing so", meaning keeping right.
- **Opposite-facing vehicles:** the existing overtake concept only recognises a pass when both vehicles faced the same way at the start. Passing a vehicle parked facing the other way is therefore not judged by `NRS_484B_777_1_o2`.
- **Street lighting:** the darkness signal counts only natural light, so both lamp laws treat a street-lit road at night as dark.
- **Avoiding a cycle:** `NRS_484D_165_3` copies the time periods of `NRS_484D_100_1` rather than depending on that rule. `NRS_484D_100_1` already defers to `NRS_484D_165_3` for parked vehicles, so depending on it would create a loop.

I proposed six new parameters, including `p.bicycle_keep_right_gap`, `p.abreast_gap_max` and `p.shared_lane_min_width`; their values await operator review. `PLAN.md` gives each decision and what would reverse it, with a "For the operator" section.

Files are in `/scratch/fsw/portfolios/av/projects/av_alpamayo_reasoning/users/wcong/WorldModelSpec/.worktrees/full221-v2/pipeline/traffic-spec-agent/results/full221-1116-1018/iter-001/plan/batch-27/`:
